description: Per-file completeness/status tracker. Score=100 means fully implemented, tested, and verified with no known gaps. TBI = ToBeImplemented (placeholder/spec is known, code is not written). TBD = ToBeDetermined (design question still open, no spec yet). Warnings = anything flagged for attention that isn't a TBI/TBD. Scope: session-touched files only (2026-06-29/06-30 HDP v2 + 4-object pipeline work) -- not a repo-wide sweep. Grow incrementally; do not backfill unverified rows.

entries.purpose: Internal pure-function layer (Phase 0-3a): Configuration/Tensor/Model/Signals pipeline wrappers + HDP edge-list DynamicState/compile_step_fn/scan_network. Not yet a public NeuralNetwork/NeuralSignal API.
tbi: configuration_to_tensor -- no Configuration->NeuronalTensor converter exists anywhere in the codebase (only the reverse, neuronal_tensor_to_configuration); needed before a true round-trip pipeline exists
tensor_to_graph -- internal flattening pass not extracted from construct()/EIGNetwork
select_signal -- thin wrapper over Signals.get() selector logic, not yet written
tbd: Whether compile_step_fn/scan_network ever expand beyond HDP edge-list (homeostasis and dense backends are explicitly out of scope; no decision made on if/when)
warnings: compile_step_fn uses Option-B (n_steps=1 wrap-and-unwrap per scan step) because the kernel's real step closure is nested/non-exported -- this re-traces/re-dispatches per step inside simulate_edge_recurrent_izhikevich_hdp; perf cost at scale (e.g. n_steps=10000) not benchmarked

step_fn's second xs_t element is a per-step PRNGKey, not a noise array -- deviates from the original Phase-2 spec because the kernel generates Gaussian noise internally from a key; documented in-file but easy to miss if not read
entries.evidence: 12/12 own tests pass (tests/test_pipeline_pure_functions.py); 1 real (non-traced) 20-step scan run confirmed numerics execute correctly

entries.purpose: Tests for _pipeline.py -- behavioral-equivalence checks (not just import success) for all Phase 0-3a functions.
warnings: No test exercises compile_step_fn/scan_network with record_dH_components=True or record_edge_current=True (the variable-arity output paths) -- only the base 5-output-tuple case is covered
entries.evidence: 12/12 pass locally; full repo suite run 3x this session, no regressions attributable to this file

Whether Model._simulate_arrays's five-way Python dispatcher (homeostasis/HDP/edge_list/dense x ablation_mode) is ever unified, or permanently stays mode-specific via _pipeline.py-style targeted wrappers

entries.purpose: Configuration builder functions (laminar_cortex_config, etc). default_spectrolaminar_config/default_nuclei_config were archived to JSON + removed from here.
warnings: default_spectrolaminar_config and default_nuclei_config are confirmed REMOVED from this file (0 grep matches) and their JSON equivalents exist at jaxfne/configs/{spectrolaminar,nuclei}_default.json -- but 19 tests across tests/test_public_builders_complete.py and tests/test_vis_phase5.py still call the old function names and fail with AttributeError. This is stale test debt from a real (not fabricated) archival, not an incomplete refactor -- the fix is updating/removing those 19 tests, not restoring the functions.

An earlier session in this same conversation reported a commit (1715ec2) landing this exact archival that did NOT actually exist in the repo at the time (confirmed fabrication, caught by the user). The archival shown here as 'real' was independently verified this session via grep+test output, not assumed from that prior fabricated claim -- do not conflate the two.
entries.evidence: grep -n 'def default_spectrolaminar_config|def default_nuclei_config' jaxfne/builders.py -> 0 matches; jaxfne/configs/{spectrolaminar,nuclei}_default.json confirmed present; 19/29 known suite failures traced to this exact root cause via a live pytest run

Needs a decision: migrate these tests to load the JSON configs via jtfne.load_config()/jtfne.load() instead, or delete the tests if the JSON-config replacement makes them redundant.

entries.purpose: Legacy Configuration-schema (networks/emitters/fields/probes) JSON archival of the removed default_nuclei_config/default_spectrolaminar_config builder functions.
